_comment: Hand-maintained offer catalog, activated by the 'Import catalog from file' button
in /admin. Built from the olmem-tech repo's authoritative definitions:
lib/site-content.ts (pricingPlans, chatbotOption, workflowCmsOptions) and the
PACKAGES map in app/api/stripe/checkout/route.ts, which hold the real names and
amounts charged by Stripe.
Importing costs nothing - no crawl, no LLM call. When the site's offers change,
edit this file and click Import again. The catalog version hashes these offers, so
an edit forces affected prospects to be rescored rather than pitched a stale offer.
Every entry in allowed_claims must be verifiable on a page in evidence_urls. The
drafting step may not exceed them.
Discovery controls, per offer:
search_queries   - the seeds sent to Tavily.
region_scoped    - true appends each region in DISCOVERY_REGIONS (the 50 states),
which is how local trades are found. False searches the query as
written; an online seller has no service area, and adding a state
returns the local retail counter instead of the ecommerce store.
discovery_weight - share of each run's query budget. Region-scoped offers generate
hundreds of queries and would otherwise crowd out a national
highest because it is the primary target.
Each run takes max(10, MAX_DISCOVERIES_PER_RUN * 2) queries, split by weight and
rotated by date, so consecutive runs explore different parts of the space.
Current focus: contractors with a thin or outdated site. The parts ecommerce
offers are parked at discovery_weight 0 - still in the catalog and still
pitchable, but no discovery budget is spent looking for them. Set them back to
3-4 when you are ready to work that market.

offers.name: Contractor Website
offers.summary: A $1,500 flat-rate website for contractors and service businesses. Up to 5 pages, mobile-first, built around a quote request funnel, with a CMS and admin dashboard, an AI chatbot, and the first year of hosting included.
problems_solved: The business has no real website, only a social media page or a directory listing
The existing site is not mobile friendly
There is no quote request form, so enquiries only arrive by phone
Service and location pages are missing, so the site does not surface in local search
The owner cannot edit their own content without calling a developer
The site looks dated enough that it costs the company credibility against competitors
ideal_customer_signals: Licensed trade contractor serving a defined local service area
Website with no quote form or contact form
Site content or copyright date that has not been updated in several years
A Facebook page listed as the business website
Single-page site with no individual service pages
Site hosted on a free website-builder subdomain rather than an owned domain
No SSL certificate, so the site is served over plain http
Template site still carrying placeholder text or stock-only imagery
Contact page listing only a phone number, with no form and no email
No photographs of the company's own completed work
exclusion_signals: Site is already modern, mobile friendly, and has a clear quote funnel
National franchise whose website is managed corporately
The business is itself a web design or marketing agency
Site displays a recent redesign or launch announcement
allowed_claims: The Contractor Website package is $1,500 flat rate and covers up to 5 pages
It includes a conversion-focused page structure, mobile-first design, and a quote request funnel
Local SEO-ready setup is included
A content management system and admin dashboard are included at no extra cost
An AI chatbot is included at no extra cost
Hosting is free for the first year, then $35 per month
Maintenance is optional at $100 per month
offers.call_to_action: Offer to send a short outline of what a lead-ready site would cover for their specific trade and service area.

offers.name: Automotive & Marketplace Website
offers.summary: A $3,500 flat-rate website for automotive parts sellers and marketplace-style stores that need supplier API connections and a catalog-aware CMS, including vehicle fitment and a garage selector, not just pages.
problems_solved: Product catalog and inventory are maintained by hand in more than one place
Customers cannot check whether a part fits their vehicle
Supplier pricing and stock are not reflected on the website
The store depends on a middleware subscription to connect supplier data
Catalog pages have no search, filtering, or fitment lookup
ideal_customer_signals: Automotive parts, accessories, or performance retailer with an online catalog
Marketplace-style store carrying supplier-sourced product data
Pages that instruct customers to call to confirm fitment or availability
Product listings with no vehicle fitment or year/make/model filter
Visible signs of stale inventory or pricing on the site
exclusion_signals: The store already runs a modern catalog with working fitment search
The business sells ecommerce or catalog integration services itself
allowed_claims: The Automotive & Marketplace Website package is $3,500 flat rate
It includes everything in the Contractor Website package
Product catalog and marketplace architecture are included
Supplier API connections are supported, including OAuth2, API key, and bearer token
An automotive CMS with vehicle fitment and a garage selector is included
Catalog, inventory, and pricing data sync is included
An AI chatbot and admin dashboard are included at no extra cost
Hosting is free for the first year, then $35 per month
offers.call_to_action: Offer to review how their catalog and supplier data are maintained today and where a fitment-aware CMS would remove duplicate work.
search_queries: heavy duty truck parts online store
auto parts catalog website with fitment search

problems_solved: Multiple locations or brands are crammed into a site built for one

No structured SEO architecture across locations or service lines
One shared login for a site that several staff need to maintain

Site referencing an ERP, CRM, or internal ordering system
Distinct divisions or service lines sharing one thin website
Careers or dealer pages implying real operational scale
Location pages that are near-duplicates of one another
exclusion_signals: Single-location business with no integration needs
Corporate site clearly maintained by an in-house web team
The business is itself a software or systems integration firm
allowed_claims: The Enterprise Website package is $5,000 flat rate
It includes everything in the Automotive & Marketplace package
Multi-location and multi-brand architecture is included
Advanced SEO architecture and schema are included
Advanced CMS modules and multi-user admin roles are included
Advanced chatbot training and lead-qualification flows are included
CRM, ERP, and automation integrations are supported
Three months of maintenance and support are included free
Hosting is free for the first year, then $35 per month

problems_solved: Visitors ask the same questions and nobody answers outside business hours
Enquiries arrive only through a contact form that goes unanswered until the next day

Staff spend time answering identical questions by phone

A published FAQ page indicating high repeat question volume
Appointment or estimate-driven service business
Contact page that lists only a phone number and business hours

The business sells chatbot or conversational AI services itself
No website exists to install it on
allowed_claims: The Smart Chat Bot is $500 one-time for a site the business already has
It provides 24/7 lead capture and FAQ responses
It runs lead qualification conversation flows
It is trained on the business's own services and FAQs
Website integration is included
